note: Lead and child skills (GDD 6.1), XP table and unlocks (Spec 2.1), and the cross-skill triangle (GDD 6.2). Child skills use the OSRS XP table; a lead's level uses the same table times its multiplier, from the sum of its children's XP plus its bonus pool.

leads.name: Rider Ability
leads.desc: How well you ride. Racing trains every Rider Ability skill at once; it also unlocks the bigger bike classes.

children.name: Balance
children.desc: Ruts, whoops and landings: faster through them and fewer crashes.

children.name: Riding Position
children.desc: A little faster everywhere, most of all on straights and rhythm sections.

children.name: Cornering and Braking
children.desc: Corner speed, and fewer mistakes in braking zones.

children.name: Jumps and Ruts
children.desc: Jump and rut speed, and safer landings.

children.name: Starts
children.desc: How well you get off the gate and into the first corner.

children.name: Overtaking
children.desc: Your chance of making a pass stick, and how little a failed one costs.

children.name: Consistency
children.desc: Steadier lap times and fewer mistakes. Never removes them completely.

leads.name: Mechanical Engineer
leads.desc: Fitting, repairing, tuning and making parts. No direct effect in races.

children.name: Engine Components
children.desc: Top end, bottom end, intake and drivetrain.

children.name: Engine Assembly
children.desc: Engine rebuilds, and better grades on engine parts you make.

children.name: Machining
children.desc: Turning and milling parts to tolerance.

leads.name: Fitness
leads.desc: Strength, stamina and recovery. Worth up to about 3% of lap time in total.

children.name: Strength
children.desc: Speed in rough and late-race sections; less arm pump.

children.name: Endurance
children.desc: Slower energy drain, most of all in Endurance races.

children.name: Martial Arts
children.desc: Sometimes turns a bad crash into a lighter one.

children.name: Wellbeing
children.desc: A little more consistency late in a moto.
